subject: ad001-lockout-storm declares promptStyle 'powershell' but its dir returns cmd.exe DIR output
description: Found by SHELL-005 on its first run. The box sets promptStyle: 'powershell', but commands.dir returns " Volume in drive C has no label. / Volume Serial Number is 8A4B-1C3D / Directory of <path>" -- that is cmd.exe's DIR. In PowerShell, dir is an alias for Get-ChildItem, whose output is a 'Directory: <path>' header followed by a Mode/LastWriteTime/Length/Name table. A student in a PowerShell lab is being shown cmd output, which is exactly the dialect confusion SHELL-004/005 exist to stop. NOT fixed here because the right output is a CONTENT decision (Get-ChildItem table formatting, and whether the author wanted cmd-style deliberately for familiarity) and changing it is a student-facing edit needing its own gates. Baselined so it does not block deploys; visible in _tools/reports/BOX_CONTRACT_BASELINE.json. Fix = rewrite AD001Config.commands.dir to emit Get-ChildItem format, or change promptStyle to 'windows' if cmd was the intent.
